g.text: Read-noise sensitivity with the same methods at every setting
Fixed 1 ms and 500 ms controls; no selection of a different best exposure at each noise level
Mean ± sample SD; n = 3 successful runs per method/condition. Reference: saved raw-data reconstruction, not object ground truth.
* Extension is not the published method. HDR total exposure: 666.5 ms/position; acquisition budgets are unequal.
